mapper.select: SELECT rr.id, rr.no, rr.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userName, rr.coupon_id AS couponId, cm.name AS couponName, rr.receive_time AS receiveTime, rr.status, rr.verify_time AS verifyTime, rr.check_result AS checkResult, rr.sync_status AS syncStatus, rr.archive_time AS archiveTime, rr.creator, rr.create_time AS createTime, rr.update_time AS updateTime FROM receive_record rr LEFT JOIN user_info u ON rr.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN coupon_mgmt cm ON rr.coupon_id = cm.id AND cm.deleted = 0 WHERE rr.id = #{id} AND rr.deleted = 0
